title: Doctor fixes you can run
summary: Every ia doctor check now carries a structured fix beside its remedy: the command as an argument vector, its flow (preview then apply, a preview flag, confirm, or immediate) derived from the command's own grammar, and what it writes; a package-manager fix names its directory explicitly, and --json gains only the fix field. Doctor adds a kits row and one kit-update row per installed kit behind, read from an update cache kept per registry, with the fix that moves each by its source (an npm package, a registry collection or a release), and a marketplace row that says when the marketplace was last checked. ia-distribution refresh-updates takes --root and --force, refreshes asynchronously and merges under the IA home's store lock. The refreshUpdates function exported from @inventarch/distribution/updates now returns Promise<UpdateCheck>, and UpdateCheck.packages may carry entries, so callers must await it. A registry collection's identity is kept beside the lock in .ia/kit-collections.json, the lock itself unchanged, and installing a collection again replaces its members. Extensions can contribute console areas, offers and checks as data.
